summary: Nora's accounts of each room, group, person and herself become short syntheses of a few traits that hold, instead of growing summaries of what was said lately.
details: Every account is re-judged when it is rewritten: a few defining traits, about one paragraph, with no quotes, lists or one-off events.
An account can no longer carry message numbers in its text.
limitations: Accounts change as each session next runs; existing long accounts are rewritten once after deploy.
